The first point I'd line to adress is the bit about the warp speed, yes it is a goof off from the writers. Yes, if you are into the technical stuff it takes you away from the story, but it's not something that turns a good episode into a bad one.

The race of black people, in my opinion, is also excusable. The tribalism you mentioned didn't struck me as particularly "black culture", if anything, it reminded me of the klingon.

What makes this episode terrible is the fact that the plot is paper thin, the pace is really slow and the performance of most of the actors was sub-par.

Let's start by the plot. You have basically an excuse informed plague to justify going to this planet and kick the story, then a "misunderstanding" no one that knows the word diplomacy would make, a needless fight-to-the-death scene and finally a cop-out from consequence. No gravity to the story whatsoever, no lesson to extract from the story, basically a b-movie type of plot.

This could have still been saved with good direction, but alas, it was not ment to be. The pacing of the story is awful. It's full of stops and sidetracks (Data & LaForge on jokes, Picard and Crusher's conversations, Weasly, etc) that keep the story from advancing. It's generally bad.
